mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_task_entry_record f SET work_rule_json=coalesce(b.config_json::jsonb->'workRule','null'::jsonb)::text FROM public.nocode_task_entry_binding b JOIN public.nocode_task_instance t ON t.id=b.task_id WHERE t.root_id=#{root} AND f.task_id=b.task_id AND f.entry_key=b.entry_key AND f.work_rule_json IS NULL
UPDATE public.nocode_task_entry_binding SET config_json=jsonb_set(config_json::jsonb,'{workRule}',CAST(#{rule} AS jsonb))::text, updater=#{actor},update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_template_version WHERE template_id=#{id} AND version_no=#{version} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_binding WHERE task_id=#{task} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY create_time,id
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_binding WHERE task_id=#{task} AND entry_key=#{key} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_task_entry_binding(id,task_id,entry_key,dataset_id,config_json,business_json,inherited,submitted_json,creator,updater) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.taskId},#{row.entryKey},#{row.datasetId},#{row.configJson},#{row.businessJson},#{row.inherited},#{row.submittedJson},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(task_id,entry_key) DO UPDATE SET dataset_id=excluded.dataset_id,config_json=excluded.config_json,business_json=excluded.business_json,inherited=excluded.inherited,submitted_json=excluded.submitted_json,updater=#{actor},update_time=now(),deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record WHERE dataset_id=#{dataset} AND deleted=0 ORDER BY create_time DESC,id DESC
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record WHERE creator=#{actor} AND request_key=#{key} AND deleted=0
SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record WHERE id=#{id} AND deleted=0
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO public.nocode_task_entry_record(id,task_id,entry_key,dataset_id,business_json,operation,record_revision,snapshot_json,work_rule_json,request_key,request_hash,creator,updater) VALUES(#{row.id},#{row.taskId},#{row.entryKey},#{row.datasetId},#{row.businessJson},#{row.operation},#{row.recordRevision},#{row.snapshotJson},#{row.workRuleJson},#{row.requestKey},#{row.requestHash},#{actor},#{actor}) ON CONFLICT(id) DO UPDATE SET business_json=excluded.business_json,record_revision=excluded.record_revision,snapshot_json=excluded.snapshot_json,updater=#{actor},update_time=now()
mapper.select: SELECT r.record_id FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record e JOIN public.nocode_handling_request r ON r.id::text=e.business_json::jsonb->>'requestId' WHERE e.id=#{id} AND e.deleted=0 AND r.deleted=0 AND r.status='APPROVED' AND r.application_id::text=e.business_json::jsonb->'resource'->>'applicationId' AND r.application_version::text=e.business_json::jsonb->'resource'->>'applicationVersion' AND r.object_id::text=e.business_json::jsonb->'object'->>'objectId' AND r.creator=e.creator
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_task_entry_record SET superseded_by=#{next},updater=#{actor},update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND superseded_by IS NULL AND deleted=0
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM public.nocode_task_entry_record WHERE business_json::jsonb->>'requestId'=#{request} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND superseded_by IS NULL
mapper.update: UPDATE public.nocode_task_entry_record SET operation='UNCHANGED',updater=#{actor},update_time=now() WHERE id=#{id} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0

UPDATE public.nocode_task_entry_record SET snapshot_json=#{snapshot},record_revision=#{revision},updater=#{actor},update_time=now() WHERE business_json::jsonb->>'requestId'=#{request} AND creator=#{actor} AND deleted=0 AND superseded_by IS NULL
